cards.role: Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer
cards.summary: HDFC Bank Ltd: reports appointment involving Anup Bagchi. The filing also identifies Sashidhar Jagdishan in connection with this transition. Role: Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer. Effective date: 27 October 2026.

person_background.text: Over three decades of experience across banking, capital markets, wealth management and insurance. Before joining HDFC Bank as MD & CEO, he served as MD & CEO of ICICI Prudential Life Insurance and as Executive Director of ICICI Bank from 2017 to 2023, overseeing retail, business and rural banking and wholesale banking. He holds a management degree from IIM Bangalore and an engineering degree from IIT Kanpur.

cards.role: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) as per RBI Guidelines
cards.summary: Bajaj Finance Ltd: reports reappointment involving Prashant Verma. Role: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) as per RBI Guidelines. Effective date: 1 February 2027.

person_background.text: Around 21 years of experience in the security domain. He has served as Bajaj Finance's Chief Information Security Officer since February 2024, joined the company as head of its Cyber Risk Unit, and previously architected security services and worked as a security auditor and consultant for domestic and international banks and insurers. He is a CISSP and co-author of security books.
